idea-plugin.name: Web Architecture Engine
idea-plugin.description: Live Web Architecture Engine (WAE) diagnostics for JavaScript and TypeScript in WebStorm and IntelliJ IDEA: layer, feature, package and Next.js runtime boundary violations with the full dependency path, rule explanations, architecture hover and documented-suppression quick fixes (Alt+Enter). Uses the project-local wae-lsp from @don-erfan/wae.
